fasta.title: Genome FASTA
fasta.errorMessage: Must be a FASTA file (.fa, .fasta or .fna), optionally gzipped
fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA used to build the Salmon index.

extra_fasta.title: Additional FASTA
extra_fasta.errorMessage: Must be an uncompressed FASTA file (.fa, .fasta or .fna)
extra_fasta.description: Additional sequences (e.g. spike-ins) appended to the transcriptome and indexed as transcripts, not decoys. Must be uncompressed.

gtf.title: GTF Annotation
gtf.errorMessage: Must be a GTF file (.gtf or .gtf.gz)
gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF for building a splice-aware Salmon index.

salmon_version.title: Salmon Version
salmon_version.description: Select the specific version of Salmon to use (see quay.io/biocontainers/salmon for available versions)

transcriptome_source.title: Transcriptome Source (optional)
transcriptome_source.description: Tool used to generate the transcriptome FASTA from genome + GTF. Use gffread for prokaryotic genomes; use rsem for eukaryotic genomes.

salmon_extra_args.title: Extra Arguments
salmon_extra_args.description: Additional arguments to pass to salmon index.
